title: Performance canary: integrate KV-aware thresholds into automated rollout guards
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: performance canaries currently use workload-agnostic latency thresholds which can either be too sensitive when KV cache hit-rate fluctuates or miss regressions that only appear under low-KV coverage. This change integrates KV-aware thresholds into the automated rollout guards so the detector adjusts sensitivity based on observed KV coverage and reduces false positives while detecting KV-specific regressions. Summary of changes: - Add kv_thresholds module: computes dynamic latency thresholds conditioned on per-route KV coverage with EWMA smoothing and minimum-sample safeguards. - Surface kv_coverage metric from runner to detector and add shard-local KV path instrumentation. - Extend detector logic: when kv_coverage >= configured_min_coverage, use KV-adjusted p50/p95/p99 thresholds; otherwise fall back to global defaults. - Add rollout guard hysteresis: require sustained violation over two consecutive evaluation windows or a combined anomaly score before triggering automatic traffic rollback. - API + Console: expose new canary config knobs (min_coverage, smoothing_alpha, hysteresis_windows, anomaly_score_threshold) with safe defaults. - Tests and benchmarks: add unit tests for threshold math, e2e smoke tests, and a 30-minute perf canary run comparing baseline vs kv-aware thresholds showing 3x reduction in false positives on synthetic KV-skip workload. Checklist: - [x] Design review (ENG-1298) - [x] Benchmarks added and documented - [x] Unit + e2e tests - [x] Feature-flag gated rollout - [x] Docs updated - [x] Observability: metrics and alerts updated Compatibility & rollout: feature gated behind canary_config.kv_aware_thresholds (default false for 1 week rollout). When enabled, the console shows a recommended min_coverage per route derived from historical traffic. Safety: introduced conservative defaults (min_coverage=0.05, smoothing_alpha=0.3, hysteresis_windows=2, anomaly_score_threshold=0.7). Detector falls back to global thresholds below min_coverage. Testing and validation: added unit tests for kv threshold math and smoothing; added integration test that injects KV-hit-rate changes and verifies no rollout when coverage transiently drops; ran internal perf canary against staging with 500 concurrent requests for 30 minutes; CI passes with two reruns after a flaky test fix. Related: ENG-1342 (console exposure), SUP-4432 (support case that spurred this), ENG-1298 (design doc). Implementation notes: kept core threshold logic pure and side-effect free for easier unit testing; metric names added: canary.kv_coverage, canary.kv_adjusted_threshold_{p50,p95,p99}, canary.kv_violation_score; alerting rule updated to include kv_violation_score. Rollout guard algorithm: combine latency violation fraction and kv_violation_score into anomaly_score = w_latency*latency_fraction + w_kv*kv_violation_score; require anomaly_score >= anomaly_score_threshold for hysteresis_windows consecutive windows before auto-rollback. Documentation: docs/perf-canary.md updated with examples and recommended settings.

release_notes: Adds KV-aware thresholds to performance canaries so rollout guards can detect regressions that only manifest when KV cache hit-rate changes. Configurable defaults with EWMA smoothing and hysteresis reduce false positives and improve sensitivity to KV-specific regressions.
short_summary: Integrate KV-aware thresholding and hysteresis into performance canary rollout guards to reduce KV-coverage driven false positives and detect KV-specific regressions.
